packageSmoke.distribution: win32-x64 unsigned candidate built from the same working tree on the Windows host
packageSmoke.model: synthetic loopback chat-completions upstream; one physical request

limitations: Headless Chrome in a non-interactive Windows session; no physical Chinese IME claim.
The packaged smoke uses a synthetic loopback model; real provider calls are reported separately in real-model.json.
View isolation is covered by runtime identity tests and the shared UI space routing, not by a dedicated Windows Chrome case.
